notes: All 25 candidates are not-a-list. The six stebnerlabs.me.gatech.edu pages belong to a mechanical engineering/materials lab (Stebner Labs, Woodruff School); the alumni profiles record degrees and postdocs done at Colorado School of Mines before the group moved to Georgia Tech, so they are outside scope on both field and institution. The HEC Paris news item 'Meet 23 of our 2023 Graduates' is the only page naming doctoral graduates with placements: Maxime Bonelli (PhD in Finance, P.23, future assistant professor at London Business School), Jing Niu (PhD in Marketing, P.23, future assistant professor at University of Liverpool) and Anicet Fangwa (PhD, P.23, no placement stated); it was classed not-a-list as a mixed master's/MBA/PhD news feature, and the integrator may cross-check these names against the HEC PhD placement page. The PolyU School of Accounting and Finance placement page lists only employer universities (accounting/finance area, no names). Nothing in this batch changes an institution assignment.
